findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - The related CI run still selects an owner-choice test that requires a new P1 to block. `tests/test_review_choice_updates_plan.py:19` imports the changed review-loop test module, so the selector at `src/forge/fasttest.py:456` and `src/forge/docskip.py:93` includes it. Its split cases at `tests/test_review_choice_updates_plan.py:69-75` return `Basket defect 1`, then `Basket defect 2`, and assert that both closes fail. The classifier makes the second finding advice, so the second close succeeds and the test never reaches the split behavior. The same assumption remains in `tests/test_review_loop_records_each_stop_choice.py:28-34`, `tests/test_land_returns_the_owner_question.py:28-34`, `tests/test_land_records_review_loop_choice.py:15-19`, and `tests/test_item_time_history.py:117-124`. Retain an earlier blocker in these cases so they continue to exercise the owner-choice and history behavior.
